name: lighttable-build
description: Build tooling for Light Table's ClojureScript and main-process sources.

scripts.build:cljs: npm run --silent build:window && node script/gen-codemirror-requires.js && shadow-cljs release app worker && node script/place-plugins.js && npm run --silent place:user-plugin
scripts.lint:cljs: clj-kondo --fail-level error --lint src test plugins/Paredit/src deploy/core/User/src
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.window.json --noEmit && tsc -p plugins/HelloTS/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run --silent lint:cljs && npm run --silent lint:js && npm run --silent typecheck
